snippet.title: Redcrest: 1993 - A First Look
snippet.description:
A first look at Redcrest: 1993 by Snooze Lose Games

a narrative-focused psychological horror set in the small town of Redcrest, CA. Working at an arcade, you witness a 20-day murder spree, uncover truths kept hidden from you, see the past, write in your diary, and reconnect with your dead mother.
